query:
FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-19T00:00:00Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-26T09:30:00Z"
        AND host.name == "db-1"
        AND event.outcome IS NOT NULL
        AND process.name == "sshd"
| STATS accepted = COUNT(*) WHERE event.outcome == "success",
        failed = COUNT(*) WHERE event.outcome == "failure"
        BY source.ip
| SORT failed DESC
